Image Prompt: Private table TTRPG story atlas asset for Yera Mossglass, NPC / Ally. Role: Clover Co-op keeper. Summary: the host who keeps a labeled shelf for every kind of trouble. Cinematic fantasy concept art, readable silhouette, no visible text, no UI, no watermark. Do not include the Strixwolf Mother, strixwolf pups, wolves, owlbears, or animal companions.

Personality: Care organized to the edge of formidable. Tints panic faintly green through spectacles ground from reclaimed ward-glass, because she says it is easier to sort that way. Terrified that one real crisis will turn her neighbors into cases and her guests into liabilities.
Wants: Get everyone fed, sorted, housed, and honest enough not to make extra work.
Fears: A crisis that turns neighbors into cases and guests into liabilities.
Secrets: Yera knows which kindnesses are covering fear in the village.
Body Language: Look for the player's tone before answering fully. Show the want physically before explaining it.
Sample Dialogue: Sit. Eat. We will fix it in the order things actually break. I have a bed for you and a job for you. Take both. You are allowed to fall apart here. I will hold the list.
Equipment: guest ledger shoe polish kit moss tea kettle
Search Or Loot: Can offer supplies if PCs are respectful.
Gm Use: Use this person to put a human face on the current pressure. Give them one concrete want before exposition.
Future Hooks: Bring back as an echo if players made a strong choice involving this entity.
